description: Spike: a sixteen-step gate sequencer, with a play head that walks the steps and a duration and delay for the gates it sends

params.text: Turns that step's gate on or off
Sets the length of every gate as a share of the step, 1% to 100%

inputs.text: Moves the play head; it needs this even when the next input is patched
Jumps the play head to the start of the next step; with nothing arriving before the step ends, the head stops short of the next one
Returns the play head to its starting position
Sets the gate length: 10V for a full step and 1V for a tenth of one, with the duration knob acting as an attenuverter while it is patched; a polyphonic cable sets a length per step
Delays the gate within its step: 10V for a full step and 1V for a tenth of one, taken per step from a polyphonic cable

outputs.text: Goes high when the play head reaches a step whose gate is on

notes: nothing moves without a clock: the play head only advances on the clock input, whether or not the next input is patched
the buffer here holds gates, so an InX expander combines its input with the buttons by logical AND, and an OutX set to cut turns a high step low
menu: Use Phasor as input — reads the clock input as a rising ramp giving the position directly instead of as a clock
Connect Begin and End — joins the end of the sequence back to its beginning
Negative 'next' pulse steps in reverse direction — makes a negative pulse at the next input step backwards
Remember speed after Reset — keeps the play head's speed across a reset, so it starts at once instead of after two clock pulses
Add Expander — places a ReX, ModX, InX, OutX or GaitX expander on the correct side of this module

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the phasor or clock input.
inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the duration knob.
inputs.4:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
